How it works

Complete Honey Process Flow

Raw Honey Intake & Storage

Raw honey is received from suppliers and stored in tanks.

Storage TanksMaterial Handling Systems

➜ Ensures safe and hygienic storage.

Pre-Heating

Honey is gently heated to reduce viscosity.

Heating Tank / Jacketed Tank

➜ Ensures:

  • Easy filtration
  • Controlled processing
Filtration

Honey is filtered to remove wax, pollen residues, and impurities.

Filter PressHoney Filtration System

➜ Ensures:

  • Clear and clean honey
  • Removal of foreign particles
Moisture Reduction

Moisture content is reduced to improve shelf life.

Honey Dehumidification SystemVacuum Evaporator

➜ Ensures:

  • Prevents fermentation
  • Meets export standards
Homogenization

Honey is homogenized for uniform consistency.

Homogenizer

➜ Ensures:

  • Uniform texture
  • Consistent quality
Deaeration (OPTIONAL)

Air bubbles are removed from honey.

➜ Improves product appearance.

Quality Testing & Inspection

Honey is tested for purity and consistency. Systems Used:

Quality Control Equipment
Storage & Holding

Processed honey is stored before packaging.

Storage Tanks
Packaging (RETAIL & BULK)

Honey is packed into bottles, jars, or bulk containers.

Bottle Filling MachineJar Filling MachineCapping MachineLabeling Machine

➜ Suitable for:

  • Retail FMCG
  • Bulk export
